summary.text: Junie Joseph, a Democrat, has represented District 10 in the Colorado House of Representatives since January 2023.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, she advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for re-election.

Joseph was born in Port-au-Prince, Haiti, and earned an associate degree from Valencia College, a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Florida, a master's degree in applied human rights from the University of York, and a law degree from the University of Colorado.
Her career experience includes working as a lawyer and human rights officer.
